app.name: Openfield

firstRun.title: Let's make your first image
firstRun.body: Add a key from {first} or {second}. It takes a minute.
firstRun.whereToGetKey: Where do I get a key?
firstRun.bodyOne: Add a key from {company}. It takes a minute.

getKey.title: Get a key
getKey.intro: You only need one key. Either company works.

openai.step1: Sign in and add a little credit under Billing.
openai.step3: Copy it and paste it in Settings under API keys.

google.step1: Sign in with your Google account.
google.step3: Copy it and paste it in Settings under API keys.

getKey.cost: Keys cost nothing to create. You pay for the images you make.
getKey.storedBody: Your key stays on this computer. Only your account on this computer can read it, and it's only sent to the company it belongs to.
getKey.introOne: You need one key to start.

settings.title: Settings

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Add a key to start making images. Your keys stay on this computer.
apiKeys.setOutside: This key is set outside Openfield, so it can't be changed here.

apiKeys.removeBody: Images you already made stay in your library.

models.title: Models
models.intro: The models Openfield can use, and what one image costs at their usual settings.
models.neverChecked: Not checked yet. Openfield checks once a day while a key is set.
models.checkAutoHint: Looks for new models from the companies you have keys for.
models.checkFailed: Couldn't update the model list. Showing the saved one.
models.ownListHint: Add models that aren't in the list.
models.ownPricesHint: Use your own prices for cost estimates.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.intro: What new images start with, how many Openfield makes at once, and what happens to an image a restart cut off.
defaults.modelHint: New images start with this model.
defaults.aspectHint: Used when the model allows it.
defaults.batchHint: How many images each press of Generate makes.
defaults.concurrencyHint: How many images Openfield makes at the same time.
defaults.enhanceHint: Rewrites your prompt with more detail before a run.
defaults.regionalFallbackHint: Some models can't edit a single area. Openfield edits the whole image and keeps your area as close as it can.
defaults.rerunInterrupted: Run interrupted images again after a restart
defaults.rerunInterruptedHint: Only for images that can't pick up where they left off. You may be charged twice.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: How Openfield looks on this computer.
appearance.themeHint: Match your computer, or pick one.
appearance.gridSizeHint: How many images fit in a row.
appearance.tipsHint: A short tip shows on the first image while it's being made.

storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: Everything is saved on this computer. Nothing is stored online.
storage.locationHint: Open the folder where your images are saved.
storage.thumbQualityHint: Higher looks sharper and takes more space.
storage.originalsOnly: Thumbnails are off. Images show at full size, so scrolling may be slower.
storage.keepDeletedHint: Leave empty to keep them until you empty the trash.
storage.clearThumbsHint: They're made again when you need them.
storage.cleanUpHint: Removes files Openfield no longer uses.
storage.backUpHint: Saves a copy of your library and its details.
storage.fixSearchHint: Use this if search misses images you know are there.
storage.emptyTrashHint: {count, plural, =0 {The trash is empty.} one {Deletes # image for good.} other {Deletes # images for good.}}

spending.title: Spending
spending.intro: Tracked on this computer. Your actual bill may differ.
spending.fromRuns: From {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}
spending.fromCanceled: From {count, plural, one {# canceled run} other {# canceled runs}}
spending.limitReached: You've passed your monthly limit. Generate anyway?
spending.exportHint: Save a spreadsheet of every run.
spending.reruns: {count, plural, one {Ran # image again after a restart.} other {Ran # images again after a restart.}} You may be charged twice.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.disclosure: Openfield sends your prompt, reference images, masks and settings to the company behind the model you pick, using your key. Their terms apply. Openfield stores nothing online and sends nothing anywhere else.
privacy.noTrackingHint: Openfield never sends usage data, crash reports or update checks.

help.title: Help
help.intro: What Openfield records when something goes wrong. Keys are never recorded.
help.logLevelHint: More detail helps when something keeps failing.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.intro: Features that are still rough. Turn them on if you want to try them.
experimental.earlyModelsHint: Adds models that aren't finished yet to the picker.
experimental.canvasFilesHint: Keeps a copy of each canvas next to your images.
experimental.upscaleHint: The program Openfield runs to make images larger.
